title: add-is-time-method-to-modelusageunit
request: Hey, could you add a handy `is_time` method to `ModelUsageUnit` so we can quickly check if a unit is a time measurement? Something like `ModelUsageUnit.MILLISECONDS.is_time()` should be True.
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_model_usage_unit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import pytest
+from langfuse.api.commons.types.model_usage_unit import ModelUsageUnit
+
+def test_is_time_true():
+    assert ModelUsageUnit.MILLISECONDS.is_time()
+    assert ModelUsageUnit.SECONDS.is_time()
+
+def test_is_time_false():
+    assert not ModelUsageUnit.CHARACTERS.is_time()
+    assert not ModelUsageUnit.TOKENS.is_time()
